integrity: Analytical proof of global geometry and boundary ownership; finite code only checks representative configurations. Self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact for monomial symbols of degree at least two and 0<|a|<=1 on classical Hardy H2; does not treat sums of monomials or weighted spaces. Earlier equivalent formulation could exist.
title: Exact reciprocal horns and sharp boundary transitions for monomial Hardy composition operators
